description: This Java enum defines various error messages related to loan rescheduling in the Fineract system. It includes methods to retrieve formatted messages with dynamic parameters.

classes.name: LoanRescheduleErrorMessage
classes.description: An enum representing specific error messages encountered during loan rescheduling processes, with methods to format messages dynamically.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns a formatted error message string by injecting parameters into the message template.

methods.name: getExpectedParameterCount
methods.description: Counts and returns the number of '%s' placeholders in the message template indicating how many parameters are needed.
